email.body1:
Kevin, saw ZEDEDA unveil the Edge Intelligence Platform at GTC and grow ARR over 250% after the $72M raise.

Growth that fast usually means more in-market accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for ZEDEDA off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kevin, quick follow-up for ZEDEDA.

At 250% ARR growth, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most CROs do not actually know how many meetings the team needs to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and recovering the quarter is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings ZEDEDA needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Kevin, last bit of proof for ZEDEDA.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how ZEDEDA's reply rate likely compares to other edge and infrastructure startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
